title: Phew!
text: Phew!. More complex than I thought and boy did it take some blood, sweat and tears to put it together! I like it though. It's nice for me because I don't have much clothes.

product_metadata.title: UDEAR Closet Organizer Wardrobe Clothes Storage Shelves, Non-Woven Fabric Cover with Side Pockets,41.3 x 17.7 x 66.9 inches,Beige
features: ✏Stable & Practical Structure: With the steel poles added to the sides and back, the wardrobe is more durable and less possible to collapse. Far from the floor, it prevents moisture and dust effectively. It’s easier to clean and you can store shoes.

✏Large Storage Space: Great size of L 41.3 * W 17.7 * H 66.9 inches, with 1 movable clothes hanging rod, 4 small and 2 large storage shelves offers you extra space both for your longer outfits and folded clothes. And you can put books, decorations or any small items in the side pockets.

✏Dustproof Cover & Waterproof Tier: Zippered dustproof cover which is made of high-quality non-woven cloth offered to keep your item away from dust and water-proof fabric tiers are easy to clean. The cloth cover can be rolled up and fixed with a Velcro, or it can be put down and closed with a zipper.

✏Convenient to use & assemble: Refer to the installation steps of the manual,insert the metal poles in the holes of the plastic joints, then put on the shelves and cover, no tools required. Please make sure all poles reach the bottom of plastic connector holes.
✏Risk Free Purchase: If you have any problems with the product, just feel free to contact us. UDEAR is devoted to creating the best Storage Cabinet as well as satisfying every customers needs.
